title: Electing-leader (morphism)
description: The recognition-discipline morphism for a swarm: given a swarm and a recognition-predicate, produce a leader-assignment naming who the swarm has elected. The math (agentic-systems.md): authority in a swarm is the aggregate of recognition cells, not installed by office. A recognition cell has shape (voter-entity, recognition-predicate, candidate-entity) with settled value 𝐭 (verified); the discipline counts votes per candidate across all players' settlings and selects arg-max. Source: swarm × predicate. Target: leader-assignment.

recognition-predicate.description: The predicate the discipline recognizes — e.g., 'recognizes-leader', 'recognizes-for-routing'.
